# Word breaking tests, using the auto model for complex
# scripts (LSTM for Thai, Lao, Khmer, Myanmar; dictionary for Chinese and Japanese).
#
# Format: input is the concatenation of the segments, which are separated by '|'.
# Everything after a '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Characters can be escaped as \u{XXXX}.

# Rule-based tests
# https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/issues/4417
A.\u{AD}B # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × Format × ALetter ÷
A.\u{308}B # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × Extend × ALetter ÷
A.\u{200D}B # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × ZWJ × ALetter ÷
A.\u{AD}א # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × Format × Hebrew_Letter ÷
A.\u{308}א # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × Extend × Hebrew_Letter ÷
A.\u{200D}א # ÷ ALetter × MidNumLet × ZWJ × Hebrew_Letter ÷
A'\u{AD}B # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × Format × ALetter ÷
A'\u{308}B # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × Extend × ALetter ÷
A'\u{200D}B # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × ZWJ × ALetter ÷
A'\u{AD}א # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × Format × Hebrew_Letter ÷
A'\u{308}א # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × Extend × Hebrew_Letter ÷
A'\u{200D}א # ÷ ALetter × Single_Quote × ZWJ × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א.\u{AD}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × Format × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א.\u{308}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × Extend × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א.\u{200D}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × ZWJ × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א.\u{AD}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × Format × ALetter ÷
א.\u{308}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × Extend × ALetter ÷
א.\u{200D}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × MidNumLet × ZWJ × ALetter ÷
א'\u{AD}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × Format × ALetter ÷
א'\u{308}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × Extend × ALetter ÷
א'\u{200D}A # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × ZWJ × ALetter ÷
א'\u{AD}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × Format × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א'\u{308}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × Extend × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א'\u{200D}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Single_Quote × ZWJ × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א"\u{AD}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Double_Quote × Format × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א"\u{308}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Double_Quote × Extend × Hebrew_Letter ÷
א"\u{200D}א # ÷ Hebrew_Letter × Double_Quote × ZWJ × Hebrew_Letter ÷
